title: Pastiera 0.85
highlights: QuickLauncher is new: open apps from the keyboard with a Spotlight-style search dialog.
QuickLauncher starts faster, can respect the active keyboard layout, and supports typo-tolerant ranking.
Status bar and variation controls are more flexible, including clearer visibility and sizing options.
App-specific messenger presets can use SYM + Enter as an additional send shortcut.
Nav Mode adds word navigation, media controls, native Ctrl passthrough, and Ctrl-hold behavior.
improvements: Shortcut assignment supports more physical keys, including Space, Enter, and Backspace.
Virtual keyboard mode, typing sounds, symbol handling, backup flows, and release stability all received smaller improvements.
bugFixes: Keyboard layout and subtype selection now avoid falling back to QWERTY when another active layout should be respected.
Selection deletion and smart Backspace behavior are safer when text is selected.
Q25 Alt mappings for zero and currency symbols were corrected.
Pastierina suggestion visibility is more stable when minimal UI settings interact.
An IME visibility loop during system keyboard evaluation was fixed.
Long apostrophe elision and several symbol/input edge cases were cleaned up.
